HARROW.STEP.PREPAREHint: The reading preparation step allows an opportunity for the Gamemaster to pre-configure which cards should appear in the reading. This step is only necessary if you want the outcome of the reading to be non-random to satisfy narrative goals. To pre-configure certain cards, drag and drop them from the Harrow Deck into either a Subject Card or Spread position.
HARROW.AddParticipantHint: Add participating Actors to the reading before preparing cards.
HARROW.SharePrepareWarning: You cannot share the Harrow reading with players until after you complete the reading preparation phase.
HARROW.ResetWarning: Resetting this reading will clear all its data. This cannot be reversed, are you sure you wish to proceed?
HARROW.RequestUnavailable: You are unable to request a card at this time because there is no other connected player who has permission to manage this reading.
HARROW.WarningIncorrectSuit: The "{card}" card does not belong to the correct suit, "{suit}".
HARROW.WarningParticipantAlreadyAssigned: This participant is already assigned the "{card}" card. Right click to remove it.
HARROW.WarningSubjectCardTaken: The "{card}" card is already assigned to participant "{actor}".
